title: Elihu Speaks: I Am Young

questions.question: Why did the three men cease to answer Job?
options: Because he was righteous in his own eyes
questions.correctAnswer: Because he was righteous in his own eyes
questions.explanation: Job 32:1 (ESV): "So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes."

questions.question: Who became angry with Job and his friends?
questions.explanation: Job 32:2 (ESV): "Then Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram, burned with anger."

questions.question: Why was Elihu angry with Job?
options: Because he justified himself rather than God
questions.correctAnswer: Because he justified himself rather than God
questions.explanation: Job 32:2 (ESV): "He burned with anger at Job because he justified himself rather than God."

questions.question: Why was Elihu angry with the three friends?
options: Because they had found no answer, although they had declared Job to be in the wrong
questions.correctAnswer: Because they had found no answer, although they had declared Job to be in the wrong
questions.explanation: Job 32:3 (ESV): "He burned with anger also at his three friends because they had found no answer, although they had declared Job to be in the wrong."

questions.question: Why had Elihu waited to speak?
options: Because they were older than he
questions.correctAnswer: Because they were older than he
questions.explanation: Job 32:4 (ESV): "Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job because they were older than he."

questions.question: I am young in years, and you are what?
questions.explanation: Job 32:6 (ESV): "I am young in years, and you are aged; therefore I was timid and afraid to declare my opinion to you."

questions.question: But it is the spirit in man, the breath of the Almighty, that makes him what?
questions.explanation: Job 32:8 (ESV): "But it is the spirit in man, the breath of the Almighty, that makes him understand."

questions.question: It is not the old who are wise, nor the aged who understand what?
questions.explanation: Job 32:9 (ESV): "It is not the old who are wise, nor the aged who understand what is right."

questions.question: Behold, I waited for your words, I listened for your wise sayings, while you searched out what to what?
questions.explanation: Job 32:11 (ESV): "Behold, I waited for your words, I listened for your wise sayings, while you searched out what to say."

questions.question: They are dismayed; they answer no more; they have not a word to what?
questions.explanation: Job 32:15 (ESV): "They are dismayed; they answer no more; they have not a word to say."

questions.question: For I am full of words; the spirit within me constrains what?
questions.explanation: Job 32:18 (ESV): "For I am full of words; the spirit within me constrains me."

questions.question: Behold, my belly is like wine that has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to what?
questions.explanation: Job 32:19 (ESV): "Behold, my belly is like wine that has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst."

questions.question: I must speak, that I may find what?
questions.explanation: Job 32:20 (ESV): "I must speak, that I may find relief; I must open my lips and answer."

questions.question: I will not show partiality to any man or use flattery toward any what?
questions.explanation: Job 32:21 (ESV): "I will not show partiality to any man or use flattery toward any person."

questions.question: For I do not know how to flatter, else my Maker would soon take me where?
questions.explanation: Job 32:22 (ESV): "For I do not know how to flatter, else my Maker would soon take me away."

key_verse_text: But it is the spirit in man, the breath of the Almighty, that makes him understand.
